snippet.title: Pizza Agent Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Pizza Agent is a co-op simulator combining pizza shop management with undercover alien investigation. Craft delicious pizzas, manage your stock, keep customers happy. And secretly scan customers to catch shape-shifting aliens. Cook, serve and scan !

Pizza Agent Steam Page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4158480/Pizza_Agent/
